3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: In the fertile fields of Qalus, the Cantuavo vineyards were among the oldest in Rizia.
3.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Friendly"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Friendly"] == true) == false)

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: They were run by a revered winemaking family now in their fifth generation, who had long ago been awarded noble status for the fine wines they provided the kingdom.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Tonight, they had invited my family and council over for the ceremonial uncorking of their latest vintage, "Romus the Red". Bottled on my coronation day, it was now ready for drinking.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I wished I was in more of a celebratory mood.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: As if that weren't enough, tensions with Pales were higher than ever. We were still awaiting the arbitration results.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: In the meantime, the Rizian navy remained deployed around the Aureus field, despite the international community's growing concern.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: And gas tankers were venturing off from Monqiz, Porte Drazon, and Fort Ales to Rumburg to fulfill our natural gas exports every single day.
15.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Rumburg_HighEnergyExport"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Rumburg_AverageEnergyExport"] == true)

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: For now, all I had to do was open a wine bottle. But even that was politicized. Hugo had stressed the importance of keeping the Cantuavo family loyal to our house.
19.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Rumburg_HighEnergyExport"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Rumburg_AverageEnergyExport"] == true) == false)

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: Wehlen's announcement at the AN had plunged the country into panic. I was besieged by demands to take action to get Zille back.

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: It wouldn't be easy. My decision to open a gold mine in the heart of Rizian wine country had angered many in the Valenqiris nobility, the Cantuavos foremost among them.

24.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
24.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) == false

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: Our motorcade rolled up to the vineyard entrance, where a festival tent decorated in the blue, white and gold of the Rizian flag had been set up.
25.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) == false

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: After a thorough security sweep, my mother Estela, Vina, Hugo and I proceeded to our table. Pabel smoothly approached and poured us glasses of sparkling water.

27.speaker: Pabel Adria
27.text: "I had the pleasure of supervising the pre-tasting with the vineyard staff. I must say, the family has truly outdone themselves this time."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "How much of it do I have to drink?"

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "It's named after me. It had better be good."

35.speaker: Pabel Adria
35.text: "Only a small sip when the first bottle is uncorked, Your Majesty. I've arranged for a substitute to be served to you the rest of the time."

36.speaker: Pabel Adria
36.text: "I honestly think you'll love it. It's light on the palate at first, but it has hidden depths."

41.speaker: Pabel Adria
41.text: "We spit it out during the tasting, Your Majesty. Unfortunately."

43.speaker: Pabel Adria
43.text: "Never, Your Majesty. We only taste enough to judge the wine's character."

47.speaker: Pabel Adria
47.text: "I hope you'll enjoy it. But let me know immediately if you don't, and I'll find one that's more to your liking."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: All three were dressed more festively than the simple formalwear they wore to council meetings, but Lucita's slinky, intricately beaded yellow gown was particularly eye-catching.

49.speaker: Estela Toras
49.text: "Oh, my. The mountains of Montaklar are on full display tonight."

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: My mother turned to me and muttered under her breath.

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Honestly, Mother. I'll have you kicked out if you insist on demeaning my councilor like that."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "You're just jealous that for once, someone else's outfit is better than yours."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: Vina nodded in agreement, but there was a wariness in her eyes.

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: Vina rolled her eyes in disgust.

57.speaker: Vina Toras
57.text: "I still don't understand what we're doing here. Especially with all that's been going on."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: Vina rolled her eyes and ran a finger along the rim of her glass.

64.speaker: Hugo Toras
64.text: "Politics, Your Highness. In case our foreign situation escalates, we'll require the support of House Toras and our home province more than ever."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "Yes, we must keep attending functions as usual. As the royal family, we've got the spirit of Rizia to uphold."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Vina has a point. President Smolak and I haven't exchanged a word since Zille. Shouldn't I make it my priority to talk to him?"

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Come to think of it, won't the Valenqiris nobility want me skinned alive for taking the side of a Malenyevist at the AN?"

74.speaker: Vina Toras
74.text: "A Valgslandian Socialist, Father, There's a difference."

76.speaker: Hugo Toras
76.text: "Many members of our house still have Valgish blood. Of course they despise the direction taken by the old empire, but some sympathy might remain."

77.speaker: Hugo Toras
77.text: "A predicament, yes. But not a crisis."

78.speaker: Hugo Toras
78.text: "Mr. Esquibel has already set up the meeting, Your Majesty. He has a team putting together our case as we speak."

79.speaker: Hugo Toras
79.text: "For now, it's important we reassure our wealthiest citizens that the situation will not affect their assets."

81.speaker: Hugo Toras
81.text: "In this case, it's especially important for our wealthiest citizens to be reassured that their assets will remain stable."

82.speaker: Hugo Toras
82.text: "All you have to do is reassure them that their assets will remain stable."

84.speaker: Hugo Toras
84.text: "That sounds perfect, Mr. Adria. But please stick to conservative pours for His Majesty. It's unbecoming of a king to get intoxicated at these functions."

85.speaker: Hugo Toras
85.text: "A prudent decision, Mr. Adria. It's unbecoming of a king to get intoxicated at these functions."

86.speaker: Hugo Toras
86.text: "Very prudent, Mr. Adria. One wouldn't want to become too intoxicated at such an important function."

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: Lucita, Elena and Laurento walked past us and were seated at the table next to ours.

88.speaker: Pabel Adria
88.text: "Honestly, it's a good fit for you. It's light on the palate at first, but it has hidden depths."

92.speaker: Pabel Adria
92.text: "I hope you'll enjoy it. But let me know immediately if you don't, and I'll find one that's more to your liking."

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: The rest of the attendees began filing in. It was a small, elite crowd, comprising barons and baronesses, viscounts and CEOs from around the region.

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: They bowed as they passed my table. Some had fear in their eyes.
96.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_WineWhiskeyDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Monqiz_Arrests"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Tyrant"] > 1)

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Do you think they're concerned about the naval standoff in the Antacean?"

101.speaker: Hugo Toras
101.text: "That and President Smolak's announcement, of course."

102.speaker: Hugo Toras
102.text: "But they're not a hard group to please. All you have to do is reassure them that their assets will remain stable."

106.speaker: Narrator
106.text: They bowed as they passed my table, but some of their smiles seemed ungenuine. I thought I heard someone whisper "Sord-lover".

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Each of them bowed as they passed my table.
107.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_WineWhiskeyDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Monqiz_Arrests"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Tyrant"] > 1) == false)

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: Estela flashed me a look of warning.

109.speaker: Estela Toras
109.text: "There's no pleasing these people, darling. Better to ignore them."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: They bowed as they passed my table, but some of their smiles seemed ungenuine.
110.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_WineWhiskeyDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == false)

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "You still command their respect after your reign as Duke of Valenqiris. A good start."

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: After everyone had settled in, the head of the winery gave a short opening greeting, then welcomed me onto the stage.

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: I stepped behind the microphone. A magnum-sized bottle of Romus the Red stood on the table behind me.

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "We are gathered here to celebrate the fruits of this land. Our land."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "I know they're not happy about my dealings with Sordland."

128.speaker: Hugo Toras
128.text: "They don't hold the Republic or its citizens in particularly high regard, no."

129.speaker: Hugo Toras
129.text: "But more pressing is Wehlen's announcement regarding Zille. You have to reassure them that their assets will remain stable."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "I am honored to lend my name to this exceptional creation, produced by the best winemakers in the country -- no, the world."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "Today, we raise our glasses to our fine province, the foundation upon which this kingdom stands."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "This wine will only grow better over time. Just like the reign of the king it is named after."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "The wines of this vineyard have always delighted our palates in times of joy and calmed our nerves in times of sorrow."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "This wine will inspire reverence for the venerable House Toras and the nation of Rizia in anyone whose lips it touches. Yes, even Sords."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "This wine will inspire reverence for the venerable House Toras and the nation of Rizia in anyone whose lips it touches."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "I have listened to my people. I know some of you have doubts about our kingdom's stability."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "I am heartened that so many of you have come here to celebrate tonight. Especially in the wake of recent events."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Yes, there are those who seek to weaken our ancient monarchy. To claim our riches for their own."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "Change is coming to Rizia. But that need not be a bad thing."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "I am but an instrument of God's will. But I know the Lord has great plans for Rizia."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "We should not be scared to look outwards. To rekindle our international friendships."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "We should not hesitate to look to our fellow royal houses for support."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Now, more than ever, we must defend our traditions and our way of life."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "I am confident that with your help, Rizia will become stronger than ever."

157.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
157.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WehlenHelp"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true) == false

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "Our brothers and sisters in Morella, for example."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "Our Wruhecist brethren in Derdia, for example."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Our Valgish cousins have not forgotten us. And we have not forgotten them."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Lespia's politics may greatly differ from ours, but they are still our neighbor."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Like that which my grandmother formed with the Kingdom of Sordland."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "The support of Rumburg and our fellow monarchies in GRACE will be invaluable."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "The Azaros' military and industrial prowess has served our kingdom well in the past, and it will in the future."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "We may have a turbulent past with the Sazons, but we cannot ignore their compassion for commoners and patronage of arts and education."

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: Lucita applauded, surprise and gratitude spreading across her face. She was the only one clapping.

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Vina quietly applauded from her seat. She was the only one.

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "The Toras, Azaro and Sazon families are all integral to Rizian prosperity. By uniting, we will stay strong."

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: There was a round of polite applause. I couldn't tell what my audience was thinking.

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "I look at this beautiful bottle of wine and dream of a day when all Rizians are able to experience such luxury."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "True nobility comes not from any birthright, but from choosing to share one's wealth."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "It is time for us to accept one another's differences, regardless of status or nationality."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "I know one thing for certain. By this time next year, we'll be raising a glass of Romus the Red to a reunited Rizia."

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: I heard a few polite claps.

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "That's all the applause I get? I am your king!"

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "I promise that if we open ourselves to new alliances, untold prosperity will be our reward."

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: The crowd hurriedly erupted into loud cheers. A representative of the winery handed me a ceremonial corkscrew and a glass.

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: I heard cheers as a representative of the winery handed me a ceremonial corkscrew and a glass.

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "It may take time and we may have to make sacrifices. But we will take back our rightful territory."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "With Valenqiris by my side, Rizia will be whole again."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "By this time next year, we'll be raising a glass of Romus the Red to a reunited Rizia."

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "I know it's traditional to do this part alone, but I'd like to invite Princess Vina to do the honors."

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "Hugo Toras, a true man of Valenqiris, will open the bottle in my stead."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "As a symbol of unity, Duchess Lucita of House Azaro will uncork the first bottle."

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: Vina blushed furiously as she got on stage. An assistant quickly procured a second glass.

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: With a look of pleasant surprise, Hugo got on stage. An assistant quickly procured two glasses.

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: With a stunned yet delighted expression, Lucita took the stage. An assistant quickly procured two glasses.

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: My daughter opened the bottle and poured us each a small amount.

199.speaker: Narrator
199.text: My uncle opened the bottle and poured us each a small amount.

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: My war councilor opened the bottle and poured us each a small amount.

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: It was delicious. A light, refreshing taste gradually developed into a darker and more complex finish.

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: I had to admit it was delicious. A light, refreshing taste gradually developed into a darker and more complex finish.

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "As the most privileged province in Rizia, Valenqiris has a duty to lead the way forward."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "I am a proud son of Valenqiris. And I assure you that my home province will always come first for me."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "We must not forget that Valenqiris is not an island."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "He chose my family to guide this country. And I will not let Him or you down."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "Yet we should not be scared to look outwards. To rekindle our international friendships."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "Yet we should not hesitate to look to our fellow royal houses for support."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "But we can no longer ignore the plight of those less fortunate than us."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "No longer can we ignore the plight of those less fortunate than us."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "I know that as King, I have tested your loyalty at times. But rest assured, your continued faith in me and in House Toras will be richly rewarded."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "I swore at my coronation that I would make Rizia whole again. And I intend to keep that promise."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "Our enemies' blood will flow as red as this wine, and our revenge will taste as sweet."

238.speaker: Narrator
238.text: The crowd applauded with gusto. Vina had a skeptical look on her face.

239.speaker: Narrator
239.text: The crowd applauded with gusto. Hugo had a relieved look on his face.

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "I swore at my coronation that I would make Rizia whole again. And with Valenqiris by my side, I will keep that promise."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "When we reclaim Zille, I will make sure that we nobles are not the only ones to reap the benefits."

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: The attendees applauded slightly more loudly.

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "But you're not here to listen to me. You're here to drink wine."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "For now, we will bear witness to the miracles that the Cantuavo family have worked with the humble grape."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "Tonight, let us remind ourselves how much Rizia still has to celebrate!"

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: There was a final round of applause as Vina and I stepped off stage. Pabel and the winery staff began circulating around the tables with wine and food.

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: There was a final round of applause as Hugo and I stepped off stage. Pabel and the winery staff began circulating around the tables with wine and food.

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: There was a final round of applause as Lucita and I stepped off stage. Pabel and the winery staff began circulating around the tables with wine and food.
252.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Vina"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Hugo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Lucita"] == true)

262.speaker: Vina Toras
262.text: "Thank you for the invitation, Father.  I thought it was a lovely speech, even if the audience didn't."

263.speaker: Vina Toras
263.text: "I'd rather you hadn't invited me on stage. I felt like a political tool."

267.speaker: Hugo Toras
267.text: "Thank you for the gesture, Your Majesty. And for a speech well executed."

268.speaker: Hugo Toras
268.text: "Thank you for the gesture, Your Majesty. I hope that will rouse our constituents where your speech failed."

272.speaker: Lucita Azaro
272.text: "It was an honor to be called on stage, Your Majesty. Especially after your mention of my house in your speech."

273.speaker: Lucita Azaro
273.text: "It was an honor to be called on stage, Your Majesty. Although I'm sure your relations weren't happy with the choice."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "It'll be fine. I had them eating out of my hand the rest of the time."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "I meant what I said. House Toras and House Azaro should be closer together."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "It was a strategic move. I need your house's favor more than mine."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "To hell with what they think. I wanted you up there with me."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "I'd lost them by the end of the speech anyway. Having you open the bottle didn't make any difference."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "Failed? Watch what you say, Your Grace."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "It's Valenqiris. They like me no matter what."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "I didn't think it went too badly."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "I spoke from my heart. If they didn't like it, that's their problem."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "I wanted my successor on stage with me. You're the future of Rizia, after all."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "Now make sure word of this gets back to your boyfriend and his family."

288.speaker: Player_Romus
288.text: "I wanted my successor on stage with me. You're the future of Rizia, after all."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "I spoke from my heart. If they didn't like it, that's their problem."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "You *are* a political tool. So am I, and so is everyone in our family."

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: Vina cut herself off and reconsidered for a moment.

294.speaker: Vina Toras
294.text: "Even if he *was*, I'm sure the Sazons will hear about this regardless."

295.speaker: Vina Toras
295.text: "It's our problem if we lose their support, isn't it?"

296.speaker: Vina Toras
296.text: "But it's Valenqiris. I'm sure they'll love us no matter what.."

304.speaker: Vina Toras
304.text: "Thank you for the invitation, Father. And for the speech."
304.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WinerySpeech_ProCommoner"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WinerySpeech_ProSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 1) == false)

305.speaker: Vina Toras
305.text: "I know, Father. But I do get tired of it sometimes."

306.speaker: Narrator
306.text: Vina slunk off to sit next to her grandmother. My mother gave me a helpless shrug.

307.speaker: Vina Toras
307.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. Thank you, Your Majesty."

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: Vina walked over to sit next to her grandmother.

311.speaker: Vina Toras
311.text: "Well, it doesn't matter what I thought, does it?"

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "I was trying to please the crowd. I didn't really mean most of what I said."

314.speaker: Hugo Toras
314.text: "It could very quickly turn into our problem."

315.speaker: Hugo Toras
315.text: "You must admit that our Valenqiris constituents were less than impressed."

316.speaker: Hugo Toras
316.text: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. But you must admit that our Valenqiris constituents were less than impressed."

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "I had them eating out of the palm of my hand, didn't I?"

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "Of course, Hugo. If there's anyone the Valenqiris nobles love more than me, it's you."

323.speaker: Hugo Toras
323.text: "You're certainly putting that theory to the test."

324.speaker: Narrator
324.text: He paused on his way back to his seat.

325.speaker: Hugo Toras
325.text: "Not to worry. We've got the rest of the evening to do damage control."

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: He paused on his way back to his seat.

327.speaker: Hugo Toras
327.text: "You'll still want to make the rounds, though. To firm up everyone's loyalty."

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text: I sat back in my own chair and took a quick sip from my glass before heading into the fray.

329.speaker: Lucita Azaro
329.text: "I wonder where you got that idea from."

330.speaker: Narrator
330.text: Still smiling, she returned to her seat.

331.speaker: Lucita Azaro
331.text: "News travels fast. The other Azaros will be pleased."

333.speaker: Lucita Azaro
333.text: "I see, Your Majesty. I hope I performed to your satisfaction."

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: She cast a last look at me before returning to her seat.

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: Her eyes widened slightly as she registered my remark.

336.speaker: Lucita Azaro
336.text: "I suppose it didn't. But thank you regardless."

337.speaker: Lucita Azaro
337.text: "I admit I wasn't sure what to make of that. You definitely knew your audience."

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: I spent a good several hours mingling with relatives and fellow nobles, posing for photographs with the winemakers and fending off journalists.

339.speaker: Narrator
339.text: Every time I attempted to sit down and eat, I was deluged with more requests. My glass, on the other hand, was constantly being refilled.

343.speaker: Narrator
343.text: I silently thanked Pabel for arranging the wine substitute. I still felt sharp by the end of the evening.

344.speaker: Narrator
344.text: By the end of the evening, I was having some trouble keeping names and faces straight.

345.speaker: Narrator
345.text: The tent gradually emptied out as the guests departed.

346.speaker: Narrator
346.text: The winery had an attached luxury villa where our delegation had been invited to stay for the night. Hugo, Estela, Vina and I began saying our final goodbyes before making our way upstairs.

348.speaker: Hugo Toras
348.text: "I'm glad you managed to find the time to come to Qalus, Your Majesty. I would call the evening a smashing success."

352.speaker: Hugo Toras
352.text: "Despite the shaky start, I think our fellow guests came away quite happy. I would call this evening a smashing success."

353.speaker: Vina Toras
353.text: "Romus the Red, long may he reign!"

355.speaker: Narrator
355.text: Vina was clutching my mother's arm, looking half-dazed.

359.speaker: Vina Toras
359.text: "Romus the Red, off with his head!"

360.speaker: Estela Toras
360.text: "That's right, darling. Now let's get you to bed."

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: I heard an uproarious burst of laughter from the other side of the room.

363.speaker: Narrator
363.text: My three councilors were still at their table. Lucita's eyes were sparkling as she regaled the other two with an apparently hilarious anecdote.

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "I'll come upstairs as well. I've had enough fun for tonight."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "I'll be right behind you. Just have to say goodnight to my staff."

367.speaker: Narrator
367.text: She gave me a knowing smile. Vina was too busy attempting a pirouette in her ball gown to register what I'd said.

369.speaker: Narrator
369.text: Vina attempted to do a pirouette in her ball gown. My mother caught her before she fell down.

370.speaker: Narrator
370.text: We went upstairs and I adjourned to my suite. The bed was even more enormous than the one I had back home.

371.speaker: Narrator
371.text: I slept more soundly than I had in months.

372.speaker: Narrator
372.text: As my family headed out, I walked over to my councilors' table.

373.speaker: Lucita Azaro
373.text: "...And he just stormed into my barracks without a stitch on, screaming, 'If you weren't a Duchess, I'd have you drawn and quartered!'"

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "What are you three so merry about?"

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: She, Laurento and Elena immediately straightened up and stopped laughing.

379.speaker: Lucita Azaro
379.text: "It was a dare back in basic training. I had to scrub the kitchen floor for three weeks, but it was worth it."

380.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
380.text: "Your Majesty. The Duchess was telling us about the time she hid her commanding officer's fatigues while he was swimming."

381.speaker: Elena Werner
381.text: "It's part of a drinking game, Your Majesty. A rather infantile one."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "Oh. Well, you three have fun. I just came to say goodnight."

387.speaker: Lucita Azaro
387.text: "Wouldn't you like to join us for a round, Your Majesty? The journalists have all gone home."

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: She had a teasing look in her eyes. I wondered how much she'd had to drink.

393.speaker: Narrator
393.text: The three of them looked at each other.

395.speaker: Lucita Azaro
395.text: "If you think you can handle it, Your Majesty."

396.speaker: Narrator
396.text: She had a teasing look in her eyes. I wondered how much she'd had to drink.

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: All three councilors got up and bowed.

402.speaker: Lucita Azaro
402.text: "Thank you once more, Your Majesty. Good night."

403.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
403.text: "Pabel! Some wine for the King, please."

408.speaker: Narrator
408.text: Pabel approached the table with the bottle of non-alcoholic wine he'd been keeping for me.

409.speaker: Narrator
409.text: Pabel approached the table and gave me a generous pour of Romus the Red.

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: He seemed to be searching for an excuse to refuse.

417.speaker: Pabel Adria
417.text: "It would be my pleasure, Your Majesty."

418.speaker: Narrator
418.text: I detected cautious excitement in his eyes.

419.speaker: Pabel Adria
419.text: "It would be my pleasure, Your Majesty."

420.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
420.text: "Good night, Your Majesty. We'll update on Wehlen soon."

421.speaker: Narrator
421.text: They sat down and began resuming their conversation.

423.speaker: Lucita Azaro
423.text: "Perfect, Pabel. I think we'd all love to learn more about you."

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: He sat down. Lucita rubbed her hands together.

426.speaker: Narrator
426.text: Pabel walked me back to my quarters, where a bed even larger than my own had been prepared.

427.speaker: Narrator
427.text: I slept more soundly than I had in months.

431.speaker: Narrator
431.text: I poured myself a small amount and turned to face the crowd.

432.speaker: Narrator
432.text: There was a final round of applause as I stepped off stage. Pabel and the winery staff began circulating around the tables with wine and food.
432.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Vina"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Hugo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_WineLaunch_Uncorking_Lucita"] == true) == false)

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: Hugo intercepted me before I could sit down.

437.speaker: Hugo Toras
437.text: "Well done, Romus. Our constituents were quite pleased."

438.speaker: Hugo Toras
438.text: "That was... interesting. I'll have to do the rounds to appease the audience members who were unconvinced."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "We're the royal family. They should be appeasing *us*."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "I didn't think it went too badly."

441.speaker: Hugo Toras
441.text: "You must admit that our Valenqiris constituents were less than impressed."

442.speaker: Hugo Toras
442.text: "Up to a point. Don't forget how they turned on your father after his marriage to the Queen Mother."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "It's Valenqiris. They like me no matter what."

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "I spoke from my heart. If they didn't like it, that's their problem."

445.speaker: Hugo Toras
445.text: "It could very quickly turn into *our* problem."

447.speaker: Hugo Toras
447.text: "Up to a point. These are the same people who turned on your father after his marriage to the Queen Mother."

448.speaker: Hugo Toras
448.text: "Many of those gathered here tonight have royal blood as well. Some of them are only three or four deaths away from the throne."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "I had them eating out of the palm of my hand, didn't I?"

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "It's Valenqiris. Everyone likes me here anyway."

453.speaker: Hugo Toras
453.text: "But relax, Your Majesty. I have a handle on it."

454.speaker: Narrator
454.text: He walked off to speak to the Cantuavos. I sat down for a brief sip from my glass before heading into the fray.

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "You know... I'm here among friends. I'll have what everyone else is having."

457.speaker: Narrator
457.text: Pabel nodded his assent and poured me a glass from the bottle of Romus the Red that was standing on the table. I swirled the wine around and took a sip.

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "Don't forget to keep everyone topped off."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "Actually, Pabel, why don't you play too?"

462.speaker: Lucita Azaro
462.text: "It didn't sound like House Toras approved of either, though."

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "Didn't I already lose them by digging a gold mine in Qalus?"

514.speaker: Hugo Toras
514.text: "Not at all. In fact, they're most appreciative of the actions you took to help the wine industry's recovery."

518.speaker: Hugo Toras
518.text: "Regretfully, many Valenqirians did see that as an attack on the local wine industry."

519.speaker: Hugo Toras
519.text: "But you have a chance to win them back tonight. Just be sure to point out the income the gold here will generate."

520.speaker: Hugo Toras
520.text: "Gold, gas *and* wine. Our province truly has everything."

522.speaker: Hugo Toras
522.text: "In the wake of the Zille announcement, it is of the utmost importance to reassure our house that its wealth and status will remain stable."

525.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
525.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) == false

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Nothing matters to me more than your continued loyalty. Have faith in your King and in House Toras, and you will be richly rewarded."
526.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) == false

529.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
529.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) == false

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "The new gold income generated right here in Qalus will help lift thousands out of poverty. Any damage done to the local wine industry is a small price to pay."

532.speaker: Narrator
532.text: I heard a few polite claps amid murmurs of discontent.

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: "The Lord has blessed this land with gold. And rest assured that the owners of this land shall reap the rewards of what He has sown."
533.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Religious"] >= 1)

565.speaker: Narrator
565.text: Due to the intimate nature of the event, we'd been asked to entrust our security to the Cantuavos' own guard force. Titus and his men would remain on standby near the vineyard's perimeter.

567.speaker: Narrator
567.text: Last to arrive was my father's younger cousin Hubertus, the reigning Duke of Valenqiris.

568.speaker: Narrator
568.text: He approached our table and removed his hat with a sweeping motion.

569.speaker: Hubertus Toras
569.text: "Your Majesty! Thank you for joining us today, on behalf of myself and the entire province."

570.speaker: Narrator
570.text: He pronounced it "provinth", the remnant of a lisp he'd had since childhood.

572.speaker: Narrator
572.text: Hugo shot me an annoyed look. Hubertus seemed to ignore the mockery.

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "It's good to see you, Your Grace. I hope your reign as Duke is going smoothly."

577.speaker: Player_Romus
577.text: "It's a wine named after me. How could I turn down the invitation?"

578.speaker: Player_Romus
578.text: "Truth be told, my cousin, I was expecting a warmer welcome."

582.speaker: Player_Romus
582.text: "Thank you for your hospitality. It's wonderful to be back."

583.speaker: Hubertus Toras
583.text: "How could it not be, with King Romus Toras on the throne?"

584.speaker: Hubertus Toras
584.text: "Nonetheless, we don't take your appearance for granted. You've been very busy lately."

585.speaker: Hubertus Toras
585.text: "Who offended you? I'll have them removed at once."

589.speaker: Narrator
589.text: He was smiling widely, but I thought I saw unease in his eyes.

593.speaker: Hubertus Toras
593.text: "We'll have to catch up later. Everyone's growing impatient for the grand uncorking."

595.speaker: Hubertus Toras
595.text: "You and the family are welcome anytime. I'm only holding the seat until Her Highness sees fit to claim it."

596.speaker: Player_Romus
596.text: "Quite right. I won't keep them waiting."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "Same here. If this wine ages any longer, it'll gain sentience."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "I've got my eye on you, Hubertus."

599.speaker: Narrator
599.text: He chuckled politely before taking his seat along with his family.

600.speaker: Narrator
600.text: He backed away slowly before taking his seat with his family.

604.speaker: Hubertus Toras
604.text: "I must thank you for your recent efforts to address our environmental troubles. We do pride ourselves on Valenqiris' natural beauty."

608.speaker: Hubertus Toras
608.text: "I've been meaning to say... they've recently discovered a species of snail in the Sijil Islands that lives off industrial waste. Perhaps that could be an expedient solution to our recent trouble."

609.speaker: Player_Romus
609.text: "A little pollution is the cost of progress. Or did you expect to profit off of Rizia's industries without having to catch a whiff of them yourselves?"

613.speaker: Hubertus Toras
613.text: "I hope the smell didn't bother you on the way over. I must say, the new mining site is beginning to raise quite the stink."
613.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisTackled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)

614.speaker: Player_Romus
614.text: "Yes, perhaps. I regret that I couldn't do more to help."

615.speaker: Player_Romus
615.text: "The landscapes here are more valuable than gas or gold. Of course they must be preserved."

616.speaker: Hubertus Toras
616.text: "I hope the smell didn't bother you on the way over. I must say, the new gas field expansion is beginning to raise quite the stink."
616.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisTackled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EsqirisGasFieldExpansion_Project"] == true)

620.speaker: Hubertus Toras
620.text: "I've heard they discovered a species of snail in the Sijil Islands that lives off industrial waste. Perhaps that could be an expedient solution."

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "Sure, until we have to send in badgers to eat the snails, hawks to eat the badgers and mountain lions to eat the hawks. Is that what you want?"

622.speaker: Player_Romus
622.text: "Your scholarly mind never stops working, does it? Rest assured your King has everything under control."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "It was for myself as much as you. I want my childhood home in Monqiz to remain as pristine as it is in my memories."

624.speaker: Hubertus Toras
624.text: "No... I suppose I failed to think through the consequences."

625.speaker: Hubertus Toras
625.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I never doubted you."

626.speaker: Player_Romus
626.text: "It smelled fine to me. But write me if the problem gets out of hand. I wouldn't want anything spoiling our province's natural beauty."

627.speaker: Hubertus Toras
627.text: "Nor would I. Thank you, Your Majesty."

628.speaker: Hubertus Toras
628.text: "It's fine, Your Majesty. I know how many demands you have on your attention and resources."

629.speaker: Hubertus Toras
629.text: "No, no. I understand the benefits the project will bring to the region. But you know the nobles here -- always concerned about their property values."

630.speaker: Hubertus Toras
630.text: "A lovely sentiment. I share it myself."

631.speaker: Hubertus Toras
631.text: "I feel precisely the same way. Only in the furthest reaches of Neqis and Sonsamia have I encountered such a mesmerizing diversity of biomes."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "It was the least I could do. God forbid the Valenqiris nobility actually catch a whiff of the industries they're profiting off of."

633.speaker: Hubertus Toras
633.text: "We're grateful for the benefits the project will bring to the region, Your Majesty. But declining property values were a concern for some time."

634.speaker: Hubertus Toras
634.text: "I convinced the Cantuavos' chef to put njorla on the menu. It's a Galmish dish made with toasted barley and raw salmon."
634.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisTackled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EsqirisGasFieldExpansion_Project"] == true) == false)

635.speaker: Player_Romus
635.text: "Raw salmon? Do you intend for the Royal Family to leave this party in body bags?"

636.speaker: Player_Romus
636.text: "Sounds delicious. I'll give it a try."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "Galmish, you say? Let me guess, it'll be a tiny portion divided equally between all one hundred guests."

638.speaker: Player_Romus
638.text: "I'm glad you've kept your taste for adventure while stuck here in Valenqiris."

640.speaker: Hubertus Toras
640.text: "Oh, I hardly miss my travels at all. Catering to this lot is its own adventure."

641.speaker: Hubertus Toras
641.text: "Ha! I don't care for Galmland's politics either, but their cuisine is fascinating."

642.speaker: Hubertus Toras
642.text: "With proper handling, it's every bit as safe as cooked. And it goes perfectly with your wine."

643.speaker: Hugo Toras
643.text: "Must you subject all of Valenqiris to the whims of your palate, Your Grace?"

644.speaker: Narrator
644.text: Hugo couldn't hide his look of disgust.

645.speaker: Hubertus Toras
645.text: "Come now. The monarchy may be rooted in tradition, but our food needn't be."

646.speaker: Narrator
646.text: He gestured at the assembled guests.
